doc: A bullets body without the section the binding names (FBL 0.7, sections 6.2 and 6.3): it reads no topic, and the first add creates the section's heading at the end of the document, then writes the item into it, both at one offset; undo removes both.

steps.doc: The first topic of a body without the section Topics: one ensure-container at the end of the body writes a line ending, the heading and a line ending, so a blank line stands before the heading; the item follows at the same offset as the first item of a section that holds none, after a line ending, so a blank line stands before it, with the marker - at column 0 (FBL 6.2, 6.3, a missing section).
